mapper.select: select * from book join registration on bk_isbn = re_bk_isbn join cart on re_code = ca_re_code where (bk_isbn=#{bkIsbn} and ca_valid="I" and ca_me_id = #{id})
mapper.insert: insert into cart (ca_amount,ca_re_code, ca_me_id) select #{amount}, re_code, #{id} from registration where re_bk_isbn = #{bkIsbn}
mapper.select:
select cart.*, bk_mainImg as ca_mainImg, re_title as ca_title, bk_subtitle as ca_subTitle, re_price as ca_price, bk_isbn as ca_isbn from cart join registration on ca_re_code = re_code join book on bk_isbn = re_bk_isbn where ca_me_id = #{id} and ca_valid = 'I' and ca_num in
#{num}

select re_title as ca_title, #{amount} as ca_amount, bk_mainImg as ca_mainImg, re_price as ca_price , bk_subtitle as ca_subTitle, bk_isbn as ca_isbn from registration join book on bk_isbn = re_bk_isbn where re_bk_isbn=#{isbn}

select o.*, r.re_title as or_title, t.or_count as or_re_title, p.pa_methods as or_methods, p.pa_approved as or_approved, t.pr_use_point as or_use_point, p.pa_num as or_pa_num, p.imp_uid as or_imp_uid
from `order` o
left join ( select pr_or_num, min(pr_bk_isbn) as pr_bk_isbn, max(pr_use_point) as pr_use_point, count(*) as or_count from particulars group by pr_or_num ) t on o.or_num = t.pr_or_num
join registration r on t.pr_bk_isbn = r.re_bk_isbn
join payment p on p.pa_or_num = o.or_num
where o.or_state = '결제완료' or o.or_state = '배송중' or o.or_state = '배송완료' or o.or_state = '구매확정' or o.or_state = '결제취소'
limit #{pageStart}, #{perPageNum}
select * , re_title as pr_title, re_price as pr_price from particulars join registration on pr_bk_isbn = re_bk_isbn where pr_or_num = #{orNum}
mapper.insert: insert into shipping (sh_name, sh_doro, sh_jibun, sh_phone) values (#{shipping.sh_name}, #{shipping.sh_doro}, #{shipping.sh_jibun}, #{shipping.sh_phone})

insert into `order` (or_num, or_me_id, or_receiver, or_payment, or_deliver, or_green_point, or_deli_date, or_sh_num, or_pay_card) values (#{or_num}, #{or_me_id}, #{or_receiver}, #{or_payment}, #{or_deliver}, #{or_green_point}, #{or_deli_date}, #{or_sh_num}, #{or_pay_card})
insert into payment (pa_num, pa_methods, pa_name, pa_or_num, pa_approved, imp_uid) values(#{apply_num}, #{pay_method}, #{me_name}, #{or_num}, #{formattedDate}, #{imp_uid})
